summary: M.S. Computer Engineering graduate from Rochester Institute of Technology (RIT, May 2026) with embedded firmware experience across STM32, Arduino, and Raspberry Pi platforms. Built bare-metal C firmware with FreeRTOS task scheduling, interrupt-driven I2C/SPI/UART drivers, and Bluetooth (BLE/Classic) sensor integration for real-time embedded systems. Comfortable across the full firmware stack, from low-level driver development to hardware bring-up with oscilloscopes and logic analyzers.

experience.title: Embedded Systems Intern
bullets: Developed a wearable gesture-recognition glove integrating ADXL345 accelerometers with Raspberry Pi and HC-05 Bluetooth (BLE/Classic) to translate 3-DoF hand motion into HID commands via Python.
Implemented a custom tap-detection algorithm using z-axis differential thresholding; resolved sensor jitter through software calibration and resolution tuning.

experience.title: General Secretary
bullets: Designed and fabricated custom single-layer PCBs in EAGLE for locomotive robots; implemented sensor communication over UART and I2C with closed-loop feedback.
Led a 25-member robotics team across national-level competitions, owning mechanical design, PCB fabrication, and electronics integration end-to-end.

experience.title: Python Developer Intern
bullets: Used Git/GitLab for version control while developing a Python GUI for real-time lab data acquisition and visualization.

projects.name: STM32 Bare-Metal Temperature Monitor
bullets: Built a Cortex-M4 temperature monitoring firmware in embedded C with timer-synchronized sensing and real-time display; achieved 3.68 KB Flash / 1.58 KB RAM at a deterministic 1 Hz update rate.
Implemented timer-triggered ADC scan conversions, interrupt-driven sample capture, and a low-level I2C driver.
Programmed peripherals directly in bare-metal C (GPIO, TIM2, ADC1, I2C1); verified timing and signal integrity in Proteus.

projects.name: Object Tracking Turret
bullets: Implemented multi-servo PWM control with interrupt-driven UART commands and user override on STM32.
Used FreeRTOS with mutexes for shared-memory task coordination; integrated VL53L0X ToF sensing (I2C) and OLED distance visualization.

projects.name: Voice-Controlled Delivery Drone
bullets: Built Arduino flight controller in C++: clamped PWM throttle mapping to 4x 30A SimonK ESCs, Bluetooth command parser with ESC arming sequence, and per-motor override.
Wrote and deployed a Linux systemd service with SIGTERM/SIGINT signal handling, auto-reconnect loop with daemon keepalive thread, and serial passthrough to hardware.

awards: 1st Prize, CanSat Workshop — Arduino Nano atmospheric data collection during free fall (2023)
Ranked 10th, Robocon — National-level robotics competition among 45 universities (2022)
